name: Story creator / editor should be the same component
description:
- Right now if I go to create a story, then go back in and edit the story, I get two different UI's.

- Align UI so that when I edit the story, the UI matches the same window I see when I'm creating a story

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Complexity 5/10. Continuing codex/row-43-shared-story-editor from current origin/main. Plan: share the create/edit window; stage existing Tasks, Specs and Links; save all changes together; update affected docs; independently validate and capture screenshots before opening a draft PR.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Independent validation found Task edits dropping unknown stored Task and Plugin bag keys. Sign-off withheld; correction and a regression check are underway, followed by fresh independent validation and screenshots.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Factory scope decision from sunny: editing must match the full creation window, including Tasks, Specs and Links tabs, with changes saved together.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Revalidation confirmed metadata preservation, but found that saving a stale Task draft can delete a concurrently added Task. Adding atomic stale-draft protection and a regression check before fresh validation.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/131. Creation and editing now share the full window with staged Tasks, Specs and Links saved atomically. Metadata is preserved and concurrent changes reject stale drafts. Independent validation passed; final head 84fcfaf passed typecheck, lint, 77 unit tests, 20 CLI tests and build. Screenshots uploaded and verified. CI running; historical storage fault-sweep timeout remains unexplained.
